scope.description: Implement an independent C++ audit executable and closed receipt for two VALIDATED_FROZEN_DATASET_GATE HCC1395 runs, including w24/w40 semantic determinism, M2 mutually-exclusive conservation, bounded historical site-key/M1 transitions and explicit NOT_COMPARABLE boundaries. Do not read BAM or recompute producer science.

assumptions: The formal w24 and w40 run roots will be supplied explicitly after both independent validator freezes succeed.
The audit executable may replay frozen artifacts and metadata but must not link producer statistical, M1/M2 or topology solver kernels.
Python remains presentation-only and will consume the C++ receipt without recomputing science.
CMake and tests/CMakeLists.txt integration remains owned by the parent task and is outside this child write set.

step_verify.step: Implement closed frozen-run metadata and artifact replay without producer-kernel linkage.
step_verify.verify: Synthetic positive fixture emits PASS; failed/non-frozen/truth-bearing/symlink/path-escape inputs exit non-zero.

step_verify.step: Compare the eight fixed science artifacts and summary projection.
step_verify.verify: Schema/version/logical rows/semantic SHA match 8/8; summary projection matches; physical-layout differences remain diagnostic only.

step_verify.step: Replay mutually-exclusive M2 conservation and bounded historical site-key/M1 transitions.
step_verify.verify: M2 four-bin sum equals m1_stable_assignments; overlap/duplicate/missing/extra fixtures fail; incompatible metrics are emitted as NOT_COMPARABLE.

step_verify.step: Produce a closed schema and tests suitable for parent CMake integration.
step_verify.verify: Direct C++17 build and the complete child test binary exit 0; source scan shows no producer science/solver linkage.

evidence.command: strict direct C++17 compile; 18-case positive/negative replay; CLI end-to-end; ASan/UBSan replay; closed JSON schema positive/negative checks; child-scoped clang-format; producer-kernel linkage scan
evidence.output_excerpt: PASS hcc1395_audit synthetic_cases=18 positive=1 negative=17; PASS HCC1395_DETERMINISM_AUDIT; semantic artifacts 8/8 equal; M2 conservation PASS.

deviations: Formal HCC1395 w24/w40 roots were not available to this child task. Synthetic verification cannot establish production parity, production scientific counts or production runtime; the parent must execute the integrated audit after both independent validator freezes.
CMakeLists.txt, tests/CMakeLists.txt, schema registry/catalog and release-gate integration were outside this child write set and remain parent-owned.
System jsonschema 3.2.0 falls back to Draft 7 although the receipt declares Draft 2020-12; integration/release must use the repository-pinned validator.
The four child C++ files pass clang-format-14 directly. The repository-wide formatting gate remains red on tracked out-of-scope files; no out-of-scope file was changed.

The repository publication repair later replaced private absolute-path strings in this fixture with portable tokens. The evidence SHA now binds that sanitized projection; scientific counters and verdict fields were not changed, and the original pre-sanitization SHA remains historical context only.
